(1) conv_rows: multi-row forwards run the fused gated conv as two launches (mk_gated_conv_store writes every row's B*x into the ring, mk_gated_conv_rows convolves every (row, channel) in parallel with mk_gated_conv's tap order) instead of one thread per channel walking all rows serially; screen 4: +3% at 1,024 (1,173 vs 1,136). (2) head_trim: rows without logits stop after the program's last persistent store (LFM3: layer 23's conv store), so layer 23's conv output, out_proj and feed-forward (~3.5% of the linear MACs per prompt token) run for the last row only; stock MLX's chunked prefill skips the same ops because it evaluates only cache state. Screen: +3.3% at 1,024 (1,282 vs 1,241). Every row that runs keeps its reference expression tree; logits sha equal to the pin on short/window/long. Expect +6% prefill at 1,024 and 4,096, less at 64.

why: mlx-arith tier: mlx-prefill-multi + head_trim on the cleaned binary (re-admission of the recommended mlx-arith configuration)
hypothesis: mlx-arith tier. mlx-prefill-multi plus head_trim: rows without logits stop after layer 23's conv store, as stock MLX's chunked prefill does (its lazy graph evaluates only the caches, so layer 23's conv output, out_proj and feed-forward never run for chunk tokens). The last row's tail then runs with one row, below MLX's vector limit, on the exact kernels (stock MLX runs its last token alone too, through qmv). Screen at 1,024: 4,821 vs 4,655 (+3.6%). Expect +3.5% prefill at every length.

why: re-admission of the decode elite on the cleaned prefill-mlx binary (decode kernels unchanged; must stay bit-identical)
hypothesis: Profile (fused-layer, 4,096-token prompt): attention is 10.8 of ~15 ms per decode token, because each head's 8-SIMD online softmax walks 512 positions serially at ~3.5 us a step. Split it: a parallel launch computes every position's q.k with mk_attention's lane ownership, fma order and simd_sum; the chain then reproduces each SIMD's recurrence over the stored scores in the same order, with the prefix max, f and es computed 32 steps at a time (max is exact in any association) and value loads pipelined. Plus one launch for q/k norms, ropes and K/V stores (-5 dispatches per attention layer) and a two-stage argmax. Expect decode at 4,096 to rise from ~65 to above 200 tok/s, at 1,024 from ~128 to ~230, and ~+15% at 64.
